name: Batman: Arkham Asylum GOTY
_run_note: 32-bit Unreal Engine 3 game. Hook = UAudioComponent::Play in the game's exe (dll/dshaptics_ue3_x86.dll, byte patterns below; the exe is not packed): one line per sound, 'ue:<FMOD project>.<SoundCue>|<owner actor>'. Every SoundCue names one FMOD Designer event of its project (an RFMODSound object), the same name the game's own sound list prints. Sounds = those projects inside the game's packages (LZO chunks, FEV1 + FSB4; tools/ue3_fmod.py). Loaded by our 32-bit version.dll beside the exe - never injected (a 64-bit engine cannot inject a 32-bit game). The game reads XInput (XINPUT1_3): Steam Input on for the DualSense; turn the game's vibration off.
_controls_note: Default pad layout (general knowledge, not read from this install): square strike, triangle counter, circle cape stun, cross run / vault (double tap) / glide when falling, L1 detective mode, R1 grapnel (user 10-19), R2 throw the batarang / use the other gadgets, L2 aim the gadget (held), d-pad picks the gadget (batarang, batclaw, explosive gel, line launcher, sonic batarang). Combat = freeflow: strike chains, counters on the warning sign, a slow-motion close-up on the last enemy's knockout. Predator rooms: silent takedowns, inverted takedowns from gargoyles, glide kicks. No ranged stream of our own, no vehicle driven by the player. The biggest moments: the counter, the slow-motion knockout of the last enemy, a silent takedown.
_names_note: Names are good: the FMOD project tells the owner (PL_ = Batman, EN_ = enemies, NPC_, PS_/AMBI_ = places, DV_ = Batman's gadgets, SP_ = scripted set pieces, MUS_, UI_) and the event tells the move ('PL_CombatImpactsSFX.Counter_Batman_Punch_Enemy_Face', 'Enemy_Punch_Batman_Face' = I am hit). Floors = one project per surface ('PL_FootSteps_MetalGrateSFX.FootStep'), so steps carry the floor in their name. 1,945 events in 580 projects read from the install; their first layer is what plays here (a layer switched on by a game parameter - 'Blocked', 'Strength' - is not followed). Not read yet: projects whose events sit under a one-word category (UI_*, SJ_*, the numbered cutscene projects 115_..705_). Which names the game really posts in play is unknown until the hook has run once (never run in the game yet).
_places_note: Arkham Island, on foot only. Water: Killer Croc's sewers and flooded corridors (PL_FootSteps_PuddleSFX / DeepWaterFX steps, the dive PL_Batman_WaterDiveSFX). Air: gliding with the cape between rooftops and gargoyles (PL_CapeSFX bm_glider_open .. bm_glider_close), being pulled up by the grapnel (DV_GrappleGunSFX Start / Loop / End), the line launcher. Scarecrow's nightmare sequences (SJ_ / SP_Scarecrow*). Metal grates, broken glass, foliage in the Botanical Gardens, dirt in the caves - all named floors.

extra_rules._note: music, menus, tapes, scanners, Batman's belt and cape rustle, foot turns, enemy voices / whooshes / steps: never a vibration

grapnel._note: R2 is the grapnel and the gadget's fire all game long (Sekiro's hook feel, on R2 here). First value, not felt
